issues.quote: But the regulator stopped with its master, and I think that is the truest thing anyone will say tonight.
issues.fact: The fact sheet says nothing about any clock stopping. It gives no reading for the atelier regulator or for the repeater.
issues.misreading: A solver could read this as the atelier regulator stopping at a time of death, and so treat a stopped-clock reading as evidence the sheet does not provide.

issues.quote: He would have wanted to be the first to strike the new century, and he would have wanted you to hear him do it.
issues.fact: The sheet gives no information about midnight or any reading near the new century. The only readings are nine, ten, five to ten, and a quarter to eleven by the narrator's watch.
issues.misreading: A solver could take this as a hint that the events ran close to midnight, a time reference the sheet does not support.
